name: Sound Wizard (for phone)
description: An audio analyser for the phone, fast enough to keep up with real sound. A sound level meter with A, C and flat weighting, Leq and calibration; a spectrogram with a live spectrum, FFT sizes up to 32768, gain, range and colour maps; a triggered oscilloscope. The analysis and the drawing run in a background worker, and nothing is recorded or sent: the sound is analysed on the device.
